name: Predator Whirl (Combat)
body:
The vulnerable will become dust in the wind and a faded memory.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Bluff 6 Ranks, Erudite Predator Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, Predator’s Cunning

Benefits: While you use this style, you may take an immediate action to do either of the following: make an unarmed strike against a target you attacked since the end of your last turn or reroll an unarmed attack against a target you hit since the end of your last turn and have just missed. Creatures who roll a natural 1 on skill checks or caster level checks within your reach provoke an attack of opportunity from you. If you use the immediate action from this feat after the target provokes an attack of opportunity from you by rolling a natural 1, they take a penalty on their next d20 roll equal to your damage bonus from Erudite Predator Style.

Special: This style’s benefit applies to finessable weapons, light weapons, and natural weapons.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
